== An Error? ==

There appears to be an error in the Abilities section of the Toveine Gazal page. It gives Tiana Noselle's strength in the power rather than Toveine's. I do not know how to find Toveine's strength, otherwise I would correct this myself. Can anyone else help? Also, if there is a better way to flag an entry for edits, please let me know. Thank you.

Edited to Add: I found the page that lists Aes Sedai strengths in the One Power and have found that Toveine and Tiana have equal strength. I am now going to make the simple edit of changing Tiana's name to Toveine in Toveine's page. :)
